202        public static float getTierProbability(int tier, float quality) {
203                //if (true) return 1f;
204                
205//              if (tier == 1) return 0.5f + quality;
206//              if (tier == 2) return 0.25f + quality * 0.5f;
207//              if (tier == 3) return 0.125f + quality * 0.25f;
208                
209                //if (tier != 0) return 0f;
210                
211//              if (tier == 1) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.5f + quality);
212//              if (tier == 2) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.25f + quality * 0.5f);
213//              if (tier == 3) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.125f + quality * 0.25f);
214                
215                // since whether to upgrade or not is now randomized, higher probability of
216                // better tier weapons being available (as they may still not end up being used)
217                if (tier == 1) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.75f + quality);
218                if (tier == 2) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.5f + quality * 0.5f);
219                if (tier == 3) return Math.min(0.9f, 0.25f + quality * 0.25f);
220                
221                return 1f;
222        }

225        public void inflate(CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
226                Random random = new Random();
227                //p.seed = null;
228                if (p.seed != null) random = new Random(p.seed);
229                
230                //p.quality = 2f;
231                
232                //random = new Random();
233
234                
235                Random dmodRandom = new Random();
236                if (p.seed != null) dmodRandom = Misc.getRandom(p.seed, 5);
237                
238                CoreAutofitPlugin auto = new CoreAutofitPlugin(fleet.getCommander());
239                auto.setRandom(random);
240
241                boolean upgrade = random.nextFloat() < Math.min(0.1f + p.quality * 0.5f, 0.5f);
242                auto.setChecked(CoreAutofitPlugin.UPGRADE, upgrade);
243                
244                //auto.setChecked(CoreAutofitPlugin.RANDOMIZE, true);
245                //auto.getOptions().get(4).checked = true; // upgrade
246                
247                this.fleet = fleet;
248                this.faction = fleet.getFaction();
249                if (p.factionId != null) {
250                        this.faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(p.factionId);
251                }
252                
253                //this.faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY);
254                
255                hullmods = new ArrayList<String>(faction.getKnownHullMods());
256                if (p.blockHullmodsWithItemReqs != null && p.blockHullmodsWithItemReqs) {
257                        List<String> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
258                        for (String id : hullmods) {
259                                HullModSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
260                                if (spec.getEffect() != null && spec.getEffect().getRequiredItem() != null) continue;
261                                filtered.add(id);
262                        }
263                        hullmods = filtered; 
264                }
265                
266//              fighters = new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>();
267//              for (String wingId : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
268//                      fighters.add(new AvailableFighterImpl(wingId, 1000));
269//              }
270                
271                SortedWeapons nonPriorityWeapons = new SortedWeapons();
272                SortedWeapons priorityWeapons = new SortedWeapons();
273                
274                
275                Set<String> weaponCategories = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
276                for (String weaponId : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
277                        if (!faction.isWeaponKnownAt(weaponId, p.timestamp)) continue;
278                        
279                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(weaponId);
280                        //if (mode == ShipPickMode.IMPORTED && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_BASE_BP)) continue;
281                        
282                        if (spec == null) {
283                                throw new RuntimeException("Weapon with spec id [" + weaponId + "] not found");
284                        }
285                        
286                        int tier = spec.getTier();
287                        String cat = spec.getAutofitCategory();
288                        
289                        if (isPriority(spec)) {
290                                List<AvailableWeapon> list = priorityWeapons.getWeapons(tier).getWeapons(cat).getWeapons(spec.getSize());
291                                list.add(new AvailableWeaponImpl(spec, 1000));
292                        } else {
293                                List<AvailableWeapon> list = nonPriorityWeapons.getWeapons(tier).getWeapons(cat).getWeapons(spec.getSize());
294                                list.add(new AvailableWeaponImpl(spec, 1000));
295                        }
296                        weaponCategories.add(cat);
297                }
298                
299                ListMap<AvailableFighter> nonPriorityFighters = new ListMap<AvailableFighter>(); 
300                ListMap<AvailableFighter> priorityFighters = new ListMap<AvailableFighter>(); 
301                Set<String> fighterCategories = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
302                for (String wingId : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
303                        if (!faction.isFighterKnownAt(wingId, p.timestamp)) continue;
304                        
305                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(wingId);
306                        if (spec == null) {
307                                throw new RuntimeException("Fighter wing with spec id [" + wingId + "] not found");
308                        }
309                        
310                        //if (mode == ShipPickMode.IMPORTED && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_BASE_BP)) continue;
311                        //int tier = spec.getTier();
312                        String cat = spec.getAutofitCategory();
313//                      if (cat == null) {
314//                              System.out.println("wfewfwe");
315//                      }
316                        if (isPriority(spec)) {
317                                priorityFighters.add(cat, new AvailableFighterImpl(spec, 1000));
318                        } else {
319                                nonPriorityFighters.add(cat, new AvailableFighterImpl(spec, 1000));
320                        }
321                        fighterCategories.add(cat);
322                }
323                
324                
325                //float averageDmods = (1f - quality) / Global.getSettings().getFloat("qualityPerDMod");
326                float averageDmods = getAverageDmodsForQuality(p.quality);
327                
328                //System.out.println("Quality: " + quality + ", Average: " + averageDmods);
329                
330                boolean forceAutofit = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FORCE_AUTOFIT_ON_NO_AUTOFIT_SHIPS);
331                int memberIndex = 0;
332                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
333                        
334                        if (!forceAutofit && member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT)) {
335                                continue;
336                        }
337                        if (!forceAutofit && member.getVariant() != null && member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT)) {
338                                continue;
339                        }
340                        
341                        if (!faction.isPlayerFaction()) {
342                                if (!forceAutofit && member.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT_UNLESS_PLAYER)) {
343                                        continue;
344                                }
345                                if (!forceAutofit && member.getVariant() != null && member.getVariant().hasTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT_UNLESS_PLAYER)) {
346                                        continue;
347                                }
348                        }
349                        
350                        // need this so that when reinflating a fleet that lost members, the members reinflate consistently
351                        if (p.seed != null) {
352                                int extra = member.getShipName().hashCode();
353                                random = new Random(p.seed * extra);
354                                auto.setRandom(random);
355                                dmodRandom = Misc.getRandom(p.seed * extra, 5);
356                        }
357
358                        List<WeaponSize> sizes = new ArrayList<WeaponAPI.WeaponSize>();
359                        sizes.add(WeaponSize.SMALL);
360                        sizes.add(WeaponSize.MEDIUM);
361                        sizes.add(WeaponSize.LARGE);
362                        
363                        weapons = new ArrayList<AvailableWeapon>();
364                        for (String cat : weaponCategories) {
365                                for (WeaponSize size : sizes) {
366                                        boolean foundSome = false;
367                                        for (int tier = 0; tier < 4; tier++) {
368                                                float p = getTierProbability(tier, this.p.quality);
369                                                if (this.p.allWeapons != null && this.p.allWeapons) {
370                                                        p = 1f;
371                                                }
372                                                
373                                                List<AvailableWeapon> priority = priorityWeapons.getWeapons(tier).getWeapons(cat).getWeapons(size);
374                                                List<AvailableWeapon> nonPriority = nonPriorityWeapons.getWeapons(tier).getWeapons(cat).getWeapons(size);
375                                                
376                                                if (!foundSome) {
377                                                        p = 1f;
378                                                }
379                                                
380                                                boolean tierAvailable = random.nextFloat() < p;
381                                                if (this.p.maxTier != null && this.p.maxTier < tier) tierAvailable = false;
382                                                if (!tierAvailable && foundSome) continue;
383                                                //if (random.nextFloat() >= p) continue;
384                                                
385                                                int num = 2;
386                                                switch (size) {
387                                                case LARGE: num = 2; break;
388                                                case MEDIUM: num = 2; break;
389                                                case SMALL: num = 2; break;
390                                                }
391//                                              if (!tierAvailable) {
392//                                                      num = 1;
393//                                              }
394                                                
395                                                if (this.p.allWeapons != null && this.p.allWeapons) {
396                                                        num = 500;
397                                                }
398                                                
399                                                Set<Integer> picks = makePicks(num, priority.size(), random);
400                                                for (Integer index : picks) {
401                                                        AvailableWeapon w = priority.get(index);
402                                                        weapons.add(w);
403                                                        foundSome = true;
404                                                }
405                                                
406                                                num -= picks.size();
407                                                if (num > 0) {
408                                                        picks = makePicks(num, nonPriority.size(), random);
409                                                        for (Integer index : picks) {
410                                                                AvailableWeapon w = nonPriority.get(index);
411                                                                weapons.add(w);
412                                                                foundSome = true;
413                                                        }
414                                                }
415                                        }
416                                }
417                        }
418                        
419                        fighters = new ArrayList<AvailableFighter>();
420                        for (String cat : fighterCategories) {
421                                List<AvailableFighter> priority = priorityFighters.get(cat);
422
423                                boolean madePriorityPicks = false;
424                                if (priority != null) {
425                                        int num = random.nextInt(2) + 1;
426                                        if (this.p.allWeapons != null && this.p.allWeapons) {
427                                                num = 100;
428                                        }
429                                        
430                                        Set<Integer> picks = makePicks(num, priority.size(), random);
431                                        for (Integer index : picks) {
432                                                AvailableFighter f = priority.get(index);
433                                                fighters.add(f);
434                                                madePriorityPicks = true;
435                                        }
436                                }
437                                
438                                if (!madePriorityPicks) {
439                                        int num = random.nextInt(2) + 1;
440                                        if (this.p.allWeapons != null && this.p.allWeapons) {
441                                                num = 100;
442                                        }
443                                        
444                                        List<AvailableFighter> nonPriority = nonPriorityFighters.get(cat);
445                                        Set<Integer> picks = makePicks(num, nonPriority.size(), random);
446                                        for (Integer index : picks) {
447                                                AvailableFighter f = nonPriority.get(index);
448                                                fighters.add(f);
449                                        }
450                                }
451                        }
452                        
453//                      if (member.getHullId().equals("grendel")) {
454//                              System.out.println("efwefwef");
455//                      }
456                        ShipVariantAPI target = member.getVariant();
457                        if (target.getOriginalVariant() != null) {
458                                // needed if inflating the same fleet repeatedly to pick up weapon availability changes etc
459                                target = Global.getSettings().getVariant(target.getOriginalVariant());
460                        }
461                        
462                        if (faction.isPlayerFaction()) {
463                                if (random.nextFloat() < GOAL_VARIANT_PROBABILITY) {
464                                        List<ShipVariantAPI> targets = Global.getSector().getAutofitVariants().getTargetVariants(member.getHullId());
465                                        WeightedRandomPicker<ShipVariantAPI> alts = new WeightedRandomPicker<ShipVariantAPI>(random);
466                                        for (ShipVariantAPI curr : targets) {
467                                                if (curr.getHullSpec().getHullId().equals(target.getHullSpec().getHullId())) {
468                                                        alts.add(curr);
469                                                }
470                                        }
471                                        if (!alts.isEmpty()) {
472                                                target = alts.pick();
473                                        }
474                                }
475                        }
476                        
477                        
478                        currVariant = Global.getSettings().createEmptyVariant(fleet.getId() + "_" + memberIndex, target.getHullSpec());
479                        currMember = member;
480                        
481                        if (target.isStockVariant()) {
482                                currVariant.setOriginalVariant(target.getHullVariantId());
483                        }
484                        
485                        float rProb = faction.getDoctrine().getAutofitRandomizeProbability();
486                        if (p.rProb != null) rProb = p.rProb;
487                        boolean randomize = random.nextFloat() < rProb;
488                        if (member.isStation()) randomize = false;
489                        auto.setChecked(CoreAutofitPlugin.RANDOMIZE, randomize);
490                        
491                        memberIndex++;
492                        
493                        int maxSmods = 0;
494                        if (p.averageSMods != null && !member.isCivilian()) {
495                                maxSmods = getMaxSMods(currVariant, p.averageSMods, dmodRandom) - currVariant.getSMods().size();
496                        }
497                        auto.doFit(currVariant, target, maxSmods, this);
498                        currVariant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
499                        member.setVariant(currVariant, false, false);
500                        
501                        //int dmods = (int) Math.round(averageDmods + dmodRandom.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f);
502//                      int dmods = (int) Math.round(averageDmods + dmodRandom.nextFloat() * 3f - 2f);
503//                      if (dmods > 5) dmods = 5;
504//                      int dmodsAlready = DModManager.getNumDMods(currVariant);
505//                      dmods -= dmodsAlready;
506//                      if (dmods > 0) {
507//                              DModManager.setDHull(currVariant);
508//                              DModManager.addDMods(member, true, dmods, dmodRandom);
509//                      }
510                        
511                        if (!currMember.isStation()) {
512                                int addDmods = getNumDModsToAdd(currVariant, averageDmods, dmodRandom);
513                                if (addDmods > 0) {
514                                        DModManager.setDHull(currVariant);
515                                        DModManager.addDMods(member, true, addDmods, dmodRandom);
516                                }
517                        }
518                }
519                
520                
521                fleet.getFleetData().setSyncNeeded();
522                fleet.getFleetData().syncIfNeeded();
523                
524                // handled in the method that calls inflate()
525                //ListenerUtil.reportFleetInflated(fleet, this);
526        }
527        
528        public static int getNumDModsToAdd(ShipVariantAPI variant, float averageDMods, Random random) {
529                int dmods = (int) Math.round(averageDMods + random.nextDouble() * 3f - 2f);
530                if (dmods > 5) dmods = 5;
531                int dmodsAlready = DModManager.getNumDMods(variant);
532                dmods -= dmodsAlready;
533                
534                return Math.max(0, dmods);
535        }
536        
537        public static int getMaxSMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, int averageSMods, Random random) {
538                float f = random.nextFloat();
539                int sMods = averageSMods;
540                if (f < 0.25f) {
541                        sMods = averageSMods - 1;
542                } else if (f < 0.5f) {
543                        sMods = averageSMods + 1;
544                }
545                if (sMods > 3) sMods = 3;
546                if (sMods < 0) sMods = 0;
547                return sMods;
548        }
549        
550        public static float getAverageDmodsForQuality(float quality) {
551                float averageDmods = (1f - quality) / Global.getSettings().getFloat("qualityPerDMod");
552                return averageDmods;
553        }
554
555        
556        public static Set<Integer> makePicks(int num, int max, Random random) {
557                if (num > max) num = max;
558                Set<Integer> result = new LinkedHashSet<Integer>();
559                if (num == 0) return result;
560                
561                if (num == max) {
562                        for (int i = 0; i < max; i++) {
563                                result.add(i);
564                        }
565                        return result;
566                }
567                
568                while (result.size() < num) {
569                        int add = random.nextInt(max);
570                        result.add(add);
571                }
572                
573                return result;
574        }

582                p.persistent = !removeAfterInflating;
583                if (!p.persistent) p.persistent = null;
584        }

586        public void clearFighterSlot(int index, ShipVariantAPI variant) {
587                variant.setWingId(index, null);
588                for (AvailableFighter curr : fighters) {
589                        if (curr.getId().equals(curr.getId())) {
590                                curr.setQuantity(curr.getQuantity() + 1);
591                                break;
592                        }
593                }
594        }
595
596        public void clearWeaponSlot(WeaponSlotAPI slot, ShipVariantAPI variant) {
597                variant.clearSlot(slot.getId());
598                for (AvailableWeapon curr : weapons) {
599                        if (curr.getId().equals(curr.getId())) {
600                                curr.setQuantity(curr.getQuantity() + 1);
601                                break;
602                        }
603                }
604        }
605
606        public void fitFighterInSlot(int index, AvailableFighter fighter, ShipVariantAPI variant) {
607                fighter.setQuantity(fighter.getQuantity() - 1);
608                variant.setWingId(index, fighter.getId());
609        }
610
611        public void fitWeaponInSlot(WeaponSlotAPI slot, AvailableWeapon weapon, ShipVariantAPI variant) {
612                weapon.setQuantity(weapon.getQuantity() - 1);
613                variant.addWeapon(slot.getId(), weapon.getId());
